meta.title: OCR Tool - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Extract text from images via cloud recognition. Supports English and Chinese Simplified/Traditional.
ocrNote: Images are processed via cloud recognition to extract text
ocrSupportedLangs: Supports English · Chinese Simplified · Chinese Traditional — auto-detects mixed languages
ocrNoText: No text detected in the image
ocrTimeout: Recognition timed out — please try again
steps_ocr-tool_1Desc: Select an image containing text — screenshots, scanned documents, or photos of signs. Supported formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP. Max file size: 50 MB.
steps_ocr-tool_2Desc: Choose the text language (English, Simplified Chinese, or Traditional Chinese). Click Extract Text. First run downloads language data (~10-20 MB) — subsequent runs are faster.
steps_ocr-tool_3Desc: Review the extracted text, make corrections in the editor, then copy to clipboard or download as a .txt file. The text area is editable for easy fixes.
desc: Extract text from images via cloud recognition. Supports English and Chinese Simplified/Traditional.
ocrBadType: Unsupported file type, please use JPG, PNG, or WebP
ocrLibError: Failed to load the OCR engine. Check your network and refresh to retry.
ui.101: Click to select or drag an image here
